scope: Ephyra UI, contextual Velum, spend forecasting and Not Organic profiles
dataBoundary: All UI evidence uses explicit fictional demo or Storybook data. No live model, speech, forecast, profile or portal edit was performed.

touchAndMotion.details: Coarse touch selects an area, chips and composer controls have 44px targets, conversation remains visible, no horizontal overflow, forecast loading animates only without reduced motion.

browserEvidence: Light and dark desktop workspace: selecting payments adds its reference chip; done returns focus to the composer.
Unavailable Velum reply retains the question and its references in an editable composer.
Unconfirmed reply pauses Send while the next draft remains editable.
Fictional account B sees an empty map composer; switching back restores only account A's unsent question.
Lost forecast acknowledgement recovers the original 14-day request after navigating across UTC midnight; dates and operation key stay unchanged.
Theme arrow keys move selected state and keyboard focus from Dark to Light.
Usage chart Home then ArrowRight reads Nov 6 recorded spend and unknown-cost count; eight table rows include the header and seven days.
At 320 CSS px, root clientWidth and scrollWidth both measure 305 px with the scrollbar; the old 320px body minimum caused the 15px overflow.
Daily forecast dots and interval band use the forecast colour; daily quantiles are never summed into a cumulative probability interval.
Team names and handles render as primary identity; DIDs remain inside closed Technical details.
reviewFixes: Forecast recovery persists the exact original input per account and stable workspace ID.
Server replays saved forecasts and Velum replies before re-reading mutable history or source revisions.
Stopping speech retains the actual operation key; successful narration chunks are reused after a later chunk is rejected.
Companion controllers reactivate correctly after React effect cleanup.
Map drafts are scoped per account and workspace; fresh words are not overwritten by a failed send.
Avatar reads are bounded while streaming, time out, and invalidate after a verified profile image changes.
Mobile setup invitation and tray headers fit the reading column; the companion composer stays within its sheet.
coreChanges: The implementation adds Velum reference, profile and forecast contracts and optional voice references. Review fixes validate real calendar days and distinguish run references when status changes.
unverified: Live Clairic forecast contract and settlement
Live Not Organic profile and portal editing
Physical microphone hardware and mobile Safari
knownLimits: Team profile details require an available Not Organic account session; missing identities are labelled unverified.
Document drafts retain their existing saved conversation and voice dialog.
The optional generated Velum asset remains a study rather than replacing production artwork.
